description: Long-poll handshake as the JS SDK builds it (start, ser, cb, v, ns), the disconnect-frame page (dframe), a start without cb, and a start with an unknown protocol version.

frames.text:
<html><body><script>
function EnvSendPing(destURL) {
try{
var xhr=new XMLHttpRequest();
xhr.open("GET", destURL, false);
xhr.send(null);
} catch (e) { }
}
function EnvDisconnect() {
EnvSendPing("/.lp?disconn=t&id=1&pw=Mm4TW7DfqK");
}
if(window.addEventListener)
window.addEventListener('unload',EnvDisconnect,false);
else if(window.attachEvent)
window.attachEvent('onunload',EnvDisconnect);
</script></body></html>

notes: A: SDK start URL: start=t, ser=<random int>, cb=<callback id>, v=5, then ns (BrowserPollConnection.ts:206-235, RepoInfo.ts:118-149). Then the dframe URL the SDK puts in a hidden iframe after the handshake (dframe=t&id&pw&ns, BrowserPollConnection.ts:376-389).

B: start without cb; start with v=4 and cb=3 (the client gives up after 10 s, recorded as http_abort; an earlier run waited 300 s without any answer); start with ls=<A hello s> and p=<app id> and cb=4.
